decision: Build issue 1 as one Python package whose seam tests are the done check
why: The repo had the glossary and two ADRs and no code, and the issue already fixed the module split
result: scoped to one writer, the Supervisor

decision: Keep Events, Sightings, and Theses in one sqlite file and fake the harness in tests
why: ADR-0002 says only the Supervisor creates Events, so two writers would fight over that file

decision: Ran the seam suite
why: The tests drive Swarm.tick and read the dashboard, Discord, and You.com fakes

decision: Did not build the image
why: The docker command is not on this machine

decision: Left the live Claude session unwired
why: claude is not installed here, and Seam 2 needs a real OpenCrawl fetch

decision: Retyped harness scripts as Any and dropped module docstrings
why: A comment pass flagged object-typed tool arguments and restated docstrings

decision: The live process posts and reads the OpenCrawl board, and a missing harness reports FALLBACK
why: No claude or codex binary is installed, so ADR-0001's custom-code path is the one that can run, and the board is the part OpenCrawl can carry

decision: Built ground-truth:local and ran the recording check inside it
why: The earlier build was skipped because docker was not installed. The daemon starts with dockerd, and the image includes the OpenCrawl CLI

decision: Published one check message and found it on the swarm topic
why: The seam suite only drives a scripted CLI, so the review asked for a real board write
evidence: OpenCrawl board message 1 on topic swarm

decision: Left inbox acknowledgement to the CLI
why: opencrawl board inbox writes the receipt before it returns, so a second ack in the adapter would fight that

decision: FALLBACK and VERIFIED both allow the process to start
why: A missing harness is the designed custom-code path, and MISSING still blocks when a binary exists but no recorded call is found

decision: Pinned the image CLI to 0.4.66 and mounted HOME/.config/opencrawl
why: The installer default tracks next, and a nested compose default does not expand HOME
evidence: Dockerfile, docker compose config with HOME=/home/ubuntu

decision: Kept ScriptedHarness and local session text
why: No claude binary is installed, and OpenCrawl has no API for custom code to upload a transcript. The dossier stays in sqlite

decision: The default harness now researches a corroborated Event and writes a Thesis
why: No claude binary is installed, so the custom-code path has to produce the Thesis the live process was leaving empty

decision: Live topic suggestions come from a ticker table
why: The spec example is TSLA to lithium and EV supply chain, and no model API is configured on this machine

decision: The dashboard prices calls only after the operator sets both rates
why: You.com dollar rates were not confirmed against the docs, so an invented rate would be a false number

decision: Left OpenCrawl hosted and Discord as a webhook
why: Self-hosting OpenCrawl and a second bot process do not change the Thesis the user reads

decision: The local process listens on 127.0.0.1:8080 and the container listens on 0.0.0.0:8080
why: A random loopback port never matches the published Docker port, and the laptop should not expose the page on the LAN

decision: Portfolio, Watch Topics, and rates are HTML form commands on the same page
why: A separate client would add a build for one user on one computer

decision: The process listens on 0.0.0.0:8080 before the recording check
why: A browser on the same computer, or a port forward, cannot connect to a server that is not running or that is stuck before it binds

decision: Production uses SystemClock; ManualClock stays for tests
why: ManualClock never advanced in the main loop, so Event closure, research time budgets and grading could not progress

decision: LiveQuotes returns the close for the requested day, or None
why: It ignored the date and reused the latest price; trading days now skip NYSE holidays too

decision: The app labels itself custom-code fallback and pauses research when the recording check fails
why: ScriptedHarness was running silently against ADR-0001, and startup continued after a failed check

decision: A new Sighting on a researched Event triggers versioned revision research
why: The old Dossier blocked fresh research, so a revised Thesis reused old evidence; coverage is tracked by Sighting id because timestamps can tie

decision: Paid calls are stored with dates; spend is per month and the budget refuses calls
why: The UI said this month for lifetime counters and nothing enforced the budget

decision: ResearchExecutor owns query dedup, budget, retries and cost recording
why: Cache lookup and paid call were separate, so identical concurrent queries could both pay

decision: Each tick stage is isolated, reported in pipeline_status, and workers are capped at 4
why: One exception stopped later stages, and worker count grew with pending Events

decision: Server-rendered pages split into styles, typed view model and renderers: Overview, Thesis, Portfolio, Track Record, Settings
why: Implements the UI design review without a framework; checked at 1280px and iPhone 13 widths with no horizontal scroll

decision: Custom-code mode passes the recording check and falls back to a local board without the opencrawl command
why: On a machine with Claude Code installed, the check looked for recorded claude sessions and paused research, though custom-code mode never starts claude; on Windows the CLI was also called without resolving opencrawl.cmd

decision: py -m ground_truth --demo runs a staged lithium-strike demo in its own database with an inject button
why: The demo code existed but nothing could trigger it from the app; staged inputs keep live news and real data out of the stage run
evidence: src/ground_truth/demo.py prepare and inject, tests/test_review.py test_demo_mode_injects_the_staged_story
